definition.name: 让步连词 even though
definition.description: even though 引导让步状语从句，表示“即使、尽管”，强调后面的转折关系。文中 I wanna try even though I could fail. 表示“即使可能失败，也要尝试”。

examples.english: I wanna try even though I could fail.
examples.translation: 我想试一试，即使我可能会失败。
examples.note: even though 从句表达让步，主句是 I wanna try。
